logic.1v8_ok: NO while VDD = 3.3 V: digital pins are referenced to VDD and EVDD/DEVDD must be the same rail. 1.8 V SPI needs VDD = 1.8 V (bottom of the range) or a level shifter
logic.SPI: mode 0 (MOSI sampled on rising SCLK, MISO changes on falling), MSB first, <= 25 MHz, SELN idle >= 50 ns (DS p16-18, p204-205)
logic.abs max: digital pins -0.3..4.0 V; analog pins 2.0 V; RF input +10 dBm (DS p187)
logic.LVDS: 64 MHz DDR, 128 Mb/s. Driver: proprietary SLVDS Vos 150-300 mV / Vod 200 mV, or IEEE mode (IQIFC0.CMV1V2=1) Vos 1.2 V, Vod 200 mV typ at 2 mA; drive 1-4 mA (IQIFC0.DRV). Receiver: Rin 100 ohm, IEEE mode input 825-1575 mV, threshold +/-100 mV (DS p22-28, p205-207)

to_brain: SCLK, MOSI, MISO, SELN (via 1.8<->3.3 V shifter, or on a 3.3 V SPI bus)
IRQ (direct, or through the FPGA) if the built-in packet modems are used
to_expander: IRQ if only I/Q mode is used (few interrupts)

second_source.differs: same family, same tools and loading; bank 3 LVDS25 inputs (9 pairs, DS1040 p3); no PLL; 100-pin TQFP 14x14 mm body; static current 296 uA

QFN-48 7x7 single row (standard footprint), 5280 LUT, one PLL, same SPI-slave loading; only 3 banks / 39 I/O; differential inputs are 'comparators' needing +/-250 mV at VCCIO 2.5 V (UltraPlus DS p26, p35), pair positions and 64 MHz DDR timing not verified

only FPGA of this size with stock >= 300 at JLCPCB; flash-based, 1.2 V core, QFN-48 6x6 0.4 mm; DS841 p13-14, p26 describe true LVDS only for GW1NZ-2 (not stocked): LVDS input on GW1NZ-1 NOT confirmed; different toolchain and loading (JTAG/flash)

notes: No stocked FPGA with confirmed LVDS inputs at JLCPCB: iCE40LP1K-QN84 stock 0; all iCE40 parts < 300.
QN84 is a dual-row QFN; no KiCad footprint or symbol; Lattice package drawing not downloaded.
No PLL in QN84: logic must run from RXCLK (64 MHz, present only while the I/Q interface is on), the radio's CLKO (26 MHz on a 3.3 V global input) or an added oscillator.
TXCLK must equal RXCLK frequency; derive it from RXCLK (DS p22-24).
Antenna: both RF ports are 50 ohm differential, one balun and one connector per band on both reference boards; no sharing with another radio is described. RF input absolute maximum +10 dBm (DS p187).
unverified: iCE40 LVDS25 'differential input threshold' 250-450 mV vs AT86RF215 IEEE-mode swing (200 mV typ at 2 mA, table only given for 2 mA): CaribouLite runs 4 mA and works, margin not computed from data.
KDS 1XXD26000MAA: JLCPCB's sheet is the DSA/DSB-SDN series sheet; maximum output swing and the exact option code not shown; AT86RF215 wants 0.6-1.6 Vpp.
Datasheet says TCXO DC-coupled and XTAL2 grounded; both reference boards AC-couple through 1 nF and use 100k on XTAL2.
Polarity naming A/B of bank-3 pairs (A = true) from CaribouLite notes, not from a Lattice pin list.
Regulator datasheets (TPS7A2012, ME6211) not read in this session.
DLW21SN900SQ2L height and RF loss as balun: only Atmel's use is the evidence.
A JLCPCB-stocked 2.4 GHz 50:50 balun: none verified (TDK HHM1517 C5159438 is marked not for new designs; Cyntec TBL-1411-245-LR C218848 impedance not read).
